title: organization_link
description: One relationship between a thing and an organization, with dates: this individual leads that school district from 2021 with the title Superintendent; this venue is operated by that company from 2005 on; this school is part of that district. The organization never changes when a relationship does: a person who changes employer gets the old link ended (valid_to) and a new link made. A link says nothing about family or about permissions: two people linked to one organization are not thereby related, and being linked gives no access. Rules the schema cannot express: the subject exists in the right collection and is live; the organization exists and is live; an organization cannot be linked to itself; subject_type, subject_id and organization_id never change after creation. Nothing else refuses a save: no overlap, loop, primary or word-fit rules.
x_retention: Kept as long as the subject and the organization exist, for history. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet. The erase and privacy hooks for individuals are not built.)

subject_type.description: What kind of thing is related to the organization: individual, organization or venue. Required. Never changes once set.

subject_id.description: The id of that individual, organization or venue. Required. The service checks it exists in the right collection. Never changes once set.

organization_id.description: The organization the subject is related to. Required. Must exist and be live. Never changes once set.

relationship.description: How the subject relates to the organization: works_for, member_of, volunteers_for, teaches_for, leads, contact_for, part_of, affiliated_with, sponsored_by, operated_by, succeeded_by or other. Required. One list for all subject types; nothing checks which word fits which subject.

title.description: The role or title in this relationship, such as Superintendent or Board Chair. Up to 100 characters. Optional.

description.description: A few words about this relationship. Up to 1000 characters. Optional.

valid_from.description: First day the relationship applies, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

valid_to.description: Last day the relationship applies, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; absent means it still applies. Nothing compares it with valid_from.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. A deleted link is a mistake corrected, not a relationship that ended. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
